children: Overview
UK oil and gas producer's H1 2026 revenue fell 3.5% yr/yr as production rose 9%
Company posted a post-tax loss, narrowing from prior year on higher operational cash flow
Production growth driven by Southeast Asia assets, partly offset by UK North Sea outage
Outlook
EnQuest tightens 2026 production guidance to 41,000-43,000 boe/d
Company expects full-year 2026 asset expenditure to remain at $670 mln
EnQuest expects group production to exceed 100,000 boe/d from 2027 after Malaysia deal
Result Drivers
SOUTHEAST ASIA ASSETS - Production growth in H1 2026 was driven by strong performance from new fields in Vietnam and Malaysia
MAGNUS OUTAGE - Six-week unplanned downtime at Magnus field reduced UK North Sea production and deferred a cargo sale, impacting cash flow and unit operating costs
CAPITAL STRUCTURE ACTIONS - Refinancing and settlement of liabilities enhanced liquidity and simplified balance sheet
